description: This file contains utility functions for managing directory entries, including filtering, normalization, and listing of user and group entries, with support for inspecting and resolving accounts.

methods.name: resolveDirectoryQuery
methods.description: Normalizes and trims a directory query string.

methods.name: resolveDirectoryLimit
methods.description: Validates and returns a directory limit number if positive.

methods.name: applyDirectoryQueryAndLimit
methods.description: Filters IDs based on query and applies limit.

methods.name: toDirectoryEntries
methods.description: Converts IDs into directory entry objects with specified kind.

methods.name: normalizeDirectoryIds
methods.description: Normalizes and filters raw directory IDs.

methods.name: collectDirectoryIdsFromEntries
methods.description: Collects IDs from entries array.

methods.name: collectDirectoryIdsFromMapKeys
methods.description: Collects IDs from object keys.

methods.name: dedupeDirectoryIds
methods.description: Removes duplicate IDs.

methods.name: collectNormalizedDirectoryIds
methods.description: Collects and normalizes IDs from multiple sources.

methods.name: listDirectoryEntriesFromSources
methods.description: Lists directory entries from multiple sources with filtering.

methods.name: listInspectedDirectoryEntriesFromSources
methods.description: Lists directory entries after inspecting account data.

methods.name: createInspectedDirectoryEntriesLister
methods.description: Creates async function to list inspected directory entries.

methods.name: listResolvedDirectoryEntriesFromSources
methods.description: Lists directory entries from resolved account data.

methods.name: createResolvedDirectoryEntriesLister
methods.description: Creates async function to list resolved directory entries.

methods.name: listDirectoryUserEntriesFromAllowFrom
methods.description: Lists user entries from allowFrom list.

methods.name: listDirectoryUserEntriesFromAllowFromAndMapKeys
methods.description: Lists user entries from allowFrom and map keys.

methods.name: listDirectoryGroupEntriesFromMapKeys
methods.description: Lists group entries from map keys.

methods.name: listDirectoryGroupEntriesFromMapKeysAndAllowFrom
methods.description: Lists group entries from map keys and allowFrom.

methods.name: listResolvedDirectoryUserEntriesFromAllowFrom
methods.description: Lists user entries from allowFrom after resolving account.

methods.name: listResolvedDirectoryGroupEntriesFromMapKeys
methods.description: Lists group entries from resolved account groups.
